meta.precision: mpmath 50 significant digits; values rounded to 12 decimals; test at 1e-10

conventions.fair: devigged probabilities in the same order as `american`
conventions.shin: p_i = (sqrt(z^2 + 4(1-z) q_i^2/B) - z) / (2(1-z)), B = sum q, sum p = 1
conventions.odds_ratio: p_i = q_i / (c + q_i - c q_i), sum = 1; logit_shift is the same method with delta = ln c
conventions.worst_case: per-outcome min over valid methods among [multiplicative, additive, power, shin, odds_ratio, probit]; not normalised
conventions.kelly: f* = (p_win*b - p_lose) / (b*(p_win + p_lose)), b = decimal - 1; stake = max(f*, 0)
conventions.ev: ev_per_unit = p_win*(decimal-1) - p_lose, push refunds stake
conventions.line_translation: integer-valued stat X. half-integer line L: over = X >= floor(L)+1. integer line L: over = X > L, push = X == L. sharp_fair_p_over_excl_push = P(over)/(P(over)+P(under)). nb2: var = mu + mu^2/r. nb1: var = phi*mu (r = mu/(phi-1)). normal: continuity-corrected, integer k <-> (k-0.5, k+0.5).
